description: Beginner runner (15 mpw, 4 days) wants first 5k in 10 weeks. Plan must not spike volume or prescribe long marathon-style long runs.

user.name: Marcus
user.experience_level: beginner — has been running 6 months, first race
user.notes: First race ever. Wants to finish strong and enjoy it.

forbidden_content: multiple hard workouts in the same week without recovery
ground_truth.notes: 10-week 5k plan for a beginner at 15 mpw. Week 1 should be close to current base (~15-18mi). Peak should not exceed ~25-28mi — 5k does not require marathon volume. Long run should cap around 6-7mi. Should include strides or light interval work by mid-plan, but easy miles dominate. 4 sessions/week matching training days.
